title: Food-Bank Stock Rotation Dashboard
originalRequest: Create a dashboard to track and rotate food-bank inventory based on expiration dates.
latestMessage: Create a dashboard to track and rotate food-bank inventory based on expiration dates.

steps.title: Map inventory database fields for stock rotation
steps.instruction: Identify the database fields representing receipt date and expiration date for inventory items. This easy task is blocked on its second attempt by agent joker-codex because the inventory database credentials provided do not grant read access to the schema metadata.
steps.acceptance: Verification of database fields required for FIFO calculations.
